subject: general
question: Which of the following platforms was the venue where Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the resumption of India-China direct flights after more than five years in August 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SCO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Indian Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** announced the resumption of direct flights between **India** and **China** during the **Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO)** summit in **August 2025**.
 
• Direct flight services between the two most populous nations had been suspended for more than **five years**, having been halted in **March 2020**.
 
• The suspension was originally triggered by the **COVID-19** pandemic, but the resumption was delayed due to the prolonged military standoff at the **Line of Actual Control (LAC)** in **Eastern Ladakh** following the **Galwan Valley** clash.
 
• The announcement signifies a major step toward de-escalating diplomatic tensions and restoring **people-to-people** ties and **economic cooperation** between **New Delhi** and **Beijing**.
 
• The decision followed multiple rounds of high-level talks, including meetings of the **Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination (WMCC)** on India-Chin
